rows.text:
- Agent boundary review approved the notification reproduction: unrelated planning updates replaced the editor and lost its selection; the focused guard now preserves it.
- Reviewer requested refreshing the Revision picker in place; this is included without rebuilding the editor.
- Agent inspection review approved separate scalar observations with unchanged source types, then found invalid scalar omission and possible first-value focus loss.
- Invalid scalar omission is reproduced; focus recording is being completed. These review findings remain open until exact recordings and the final checkpoint pass.
